335:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I don't understand... What on earth for...?」

335:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding! I was acting serious, which isn't like me at all!」

335:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... Since we can't know what tomorrow holds, I'll put off our ace pilot celebrations until next time.」

335:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I have a dimensional merchant's grit! $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will stay open under any circumstances!」

335:t_10:10.en:

「Then...! Here's to your future prospects! Let's get fired up again today... Business, business!」

336:t_000:0.en:
$n
「$$桂$$, will you be all right on your own?」

336:t_000:1.en:
$$桂$$
「It's my first outing in a while. I'll show you a one-machine charge.」

336:t_000:3.en:
$n
「I'll get to see how cool you are too.」

336:t_000:4.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
(For now, $n seems to be all right...)

336:t_000:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
(He... started living with his dad after his mom died, right?)

336:t_000:7.en:
$$マオ$$
(He talks about his dad and sister here and there, but he won't talk at all about the time before that.)

336:t_000:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Maybe his mom is the reason he's the quiet type...)

336:t_000:10.en:
$$カトル$$
(You seem worried, Miss $$スズネ$$.)

336:t_000:11.en:
$$マオ$$
(But $n is trying to keep the darker parts of his heart from showing. He's growing up.)

336:t_000:12.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「They're coming...! All units, stay alert!」

336:t_001:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That machine... It's $$サルディアス$$!」

336:t_001:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh... Hello. It's been a while.」

336:t_001:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「What a misfortune you've suffered. Most of your comrades were sent to the far reaches of outer space.」

336:t_001:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So you know all about our situation.」

336:t_001:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, this much is easy. $$サイデリアル$$ operates throughout the galaxy, but our main force is at the galactic center.」

336:t_001:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「So basically, you've been banished to a dead-end job out on the frontier.」

336:t_001:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You're being modest. Surely you know Earth has the power to determine the galaxy's fate.」

336:t_001:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So while our numbers are at the galactic center, our quality... our elite troops, so to speak, are deployed here.」

336:t_001:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「After all, His Majesty $$アウストラリス$$, who leads $$サイデリアル$$, is here.」

336:t_001:9.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$...!」

336:t_001:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「With $$サイデリアル$$'s ruler on Earth, that man's words probably aren't lies.」

336:t_001:11.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Then let me ask you. Why does $$サイデリアル$$ regard $$マーティアル$$ as an enemy?」

336:t_001:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Apparently, they dislike the god those people worship. I don't know the details.」

336:t_001:13.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm sorry. That's what being middle management is like, yes.」

336:t_001:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$サルディアス$$... Looking at you and those $$リアクター$$s, I can believe you've sent your elite to Earth.」

336:t_001:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But judging by $$ギルター$$, $$サイデリアル$$'s overall standard doesn't seem very high.」

336:t_001:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That's what I'd expect of you, $$ゼロ$$. I can't argue when you bring him up.」

336:t_001:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now I must show you our true strength, for the pride of $$サイデリアル$$.」

336:t_001:19.en:
$$桂$$
「You seem like a very slippery customer!」

336:t_001:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, Mr. $$特異点$$! I wondered why I couldn't find you, and here you are!」

336:t_001:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「This is lucky. Then I'll dispose of you all together.」

336:t_001:22.en:
$$桂$$
「Like hell you will! I finally come out, then it's over right away? I'd be like a cicada!」

336:t_001:23.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, attack! Intercept the enemy and protect $$スコート・ラボ$$!」

336:t_001:24.en:
$$カレン$$
($$エスター$$... We'll protect this lab that's so important to you!)

336:t_002:0.en:

「Be careful! Enemy reinforcements are coming!」

336:t_003:7.en:

336:t_003:9.en:
